messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

message.content:
Progress: Roger attended the first session and reported that he is not feeling the greatest.
He described a tough time focusing, and he said that when his focus feels off, a lot of things feel off.
His anxiety score was 2 and his depression score was 3, which are not too bad.
The lack of focus is distressing to him.
He is staying at the Turning Point shelter.
He is collecting disability for traumatic brain injury.
He discussed a history of substance use.
He said he has no current desire to use because it causes too many problems.
The intervention used was supportive counseling with validation of his current distress.
The intervention also included psychoeducation about anxiety, depression, and concentration.
The intervention included brief motivational interviewing to support his stated preference to avoid substance use.
The response method was client-centered feedback, collaborative goal setting, and problem solving.
What is his current daily routine for supporting focus?
What can reduce stress while he is staying at the Turning Point shelter?
What simple strategy can he use to track attention?
How often can he complete a brief mood and focus check?
What support can he access during the disability process?
When will he review his goals between sessions?
